title: 爸妈来过年
title_en: Mum and Dad come for New Year

title_tr.fa: آمدن پدر و مادر برای سال نو

lines.text: 过完年，爸爸妈妈要回去了，小雨说：“明年我一定早点儿抢票。”
lines.py: guò wán nián, bà ba mā ma yào huí qù le, Xiǎo yǔ shuō: “míng nián wǒ yí dìng zǎo diǎn r qiǎng piào.”
lines.en: After the holiday, when her parents are about to leave, Xiaoyu says, "Next year I'll definitely start trying for tickets earlier."

lines.text: 爸爸却摆摆手：“别抢了，明年还是我们来。在北京过年，不用走亲戚，多轻松！”
lines.py: bà ba què bǎi bǎi shǒu: “bié qiǎng le, míng nián hái shi wǒ men lái. zài Běi jīng guò nián, bú yòng zǒu qīn qi, duō qīng sōng!”
lines.en: But her dad waves the idea away. "Don't bother. Next year we'll come here again. New Year in Beijing, no visiting relatives. So relaxing!"
